import html # Predefined HTML template for blog posts. The placeholders {title} and {body} # will be replaced by the sanitized headline and text respectively. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def display_blog_entry(headline: str, text: str) -> str: """ Format and sanitize a blog entry for safe HTML display. Parameters ---------- headline : str The title or headline of the blog post. text : str The full body content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A string containing the sanitized, HTML-formatted blog post. Raises ------ TypeError If either argument is not a string. """ if not isinstance(headline, str): raise TypeError("headline must be a string") if not isinstance(text, str): raise TypeError("text must be a string") # Escape HTML special characters to prevent XSS attacks. safe_headline = html.escape(headline, quote=True) # Preserve line breaks in the body by converting newlines to
. safe_body = html.escape(text, quote=True).replace("\n", "
") return BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_headline, body=safe_body)
